text.p: The Swissair airline unit of SAir Group is currently seeking more airline partnerships in Asia and is looking to further reduce operating costs, Swissair chief operating officer Jeffrey Katz said.

"We need more partners in Asia," Katz told a group of business journalists. He said that although Swissair had a strong alliance with Singapore Airlines, the Asian market was so vast that more partners were needed.
He declined to say which airline might be the desired second partner for Swissair.
He also said the airline had no choice but to cut costs.
"The market demands this. All airlines are moving in this direction," he said.
He also repeated that the airline has a goal of achieving a cost level of some seven Swiss centimes per seat kilometre.
